authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.3 classifies "E" as passive here — the exponent-separator property is "e" — and 4.7.4 sets "The prefix ... to contain all passive characters in the sub-picture to the left of the leftmost active character", so "E" is the prefix. 4.7.5 pads the rounded 0 with leading zero digits to the minimum-integer-part-size of 3, then removes the decimal-separator because no digits follow it.
